alternatives.reason: Existing Python importer is useful for validation but does not match the planned Go product API runtime boundary.
Firestore, connectors and cloud deployment add cost and authorization before the read-only contract is proven.

architecture_impact: Introduces the first Go product boundary for a read-only Project Registry.
Keeps filesystem manifest import behind a contract-oriented adapter.
Treats the Python importer as a comparison oracle, not as the ContextRail source of truth.
Does not add persistence, authentication, provider connectors or deployment control.
cost_assumptions: Local execution has no Cloud Run, Firestore or connector cost.
Go standard library is preferred; any YAML dependency must be pinned and evidenced before implementation.
unknowns: Final Go API routing and storage interfaces after the contract spike.
Whether production consumers require a YAML parser beyond the current fixture shapes.
Authentication and Project membership policy for a future API surface.

human_decision.reason: Human review accepted the read-only Go Project Registry package for local development/testing. This does not authorize Cloud Run, IAM, secrets, consumer-source mutation or production activity.
